comment: Just a simple sentence as his comment, and you will have your very-low-grade exam back. The writing exam is made of three responses. You may do pretty well on two of them, then a huge hit on the remaining one. I will just say there is no room for error. And remember, this course is basically for General Education.

Very interesting class that introduced me to concepts I had never learned about before. You submit weekly questions and have 3 exams. He grades harshly on participation, but the exams are not hard if you study because he provides the exact questions that will be on exams. Super funny and approachable.

McDaniel is a great prof. He is funny and helpful, you can tell he actually cares about students. He is very chill and doesnt care about attendance. He dedicates a lot of time to practicing problems in class. The homework assignments are not too long or difficult. The tests were hard, but he works with each student to try and help everyone succeed.

McDaniel is a great prof. Just have to take good notes and participate in class, and the tests should work themselves out for you. He finds a way to make even the dullest of philosophical arguments engaging and humorous, and overall very interesting for a Gen Ed. Highly recommend.

Great professor! He does not care about attendance and gives lots of curves on assignments. If you are really trying to learn the subject, he is always willing to work through the problems with you/send videos with notes. His lectures are clear and he makes class fun. The course was difficult for me, but he made it easy to get a decent grade.

This is one of those classes where you either get the material or you just don't. It feels like learning a new language. But the professor is great and so chill. He doesn't care about attendance and the weekly hw is not graded for accuracy. He gives curves and extra credit on exams, and is funny. Very hard class for me but not because of him.

McDaniel has an amazing personality and makes this class so much fun- everyone is honestly there to get out of calc and he knows that (he doesnt like this class so much either) but he is great at teaching, textbook is free, be prepared to do problems on the board, he gives lots of curves and HW is copied from textbook for an easy A on it

Professor McDaniel is definitely one of the best professors I've had so far. He explains the material in an understandable and funny way. I did not expect to enjoy philosophy at all but I would take his class again if I had the chance. The class was mostly lectures though so if that doesn't work for you it might not be as enjoyable.

Professor McDaniel is my favorite professor so far at UR. I took this class as a general education requirement for English and I certainly recommend this to anyone. He is very funny and engaging. Professor McDaniel cares a lot about participation. The only assignments were three tests but he is clear about his expectations.
LOTS of reading!! Paper topics were disjointed and spread to thin, but he wanted specifics. Not an easy A for sure.
Not my fav prof. I found material/teaching style unclear -- leading to difficulty all semester

One of the best profs I've had at UR by far. Really goes out of his way to make sure the students understand the material, which can sometimes be difficult. Makes homework 10% of final grade (all the answers are in the book!), and curves grades when he feels it would be beneficial. Definitely take for math requirement, or any other class!!

Such a great professor- really cares about us understanding the material, really patient with making theories clear (especially considering we had no philosophy experience), super accessible and helpful during office hours, makes class something to look forward to. Registered as one of my backup classes, and now I'm going to minor because of him
This guy is great best Gen Ed Course on Campus by far, 101 is a breeze.
McDaniel is great! Only two papers, a midterm, and a final. Definitely take this if you need an english credit.

McDaniel is the best. After taking his class I want to major in logic. It was fun and helpful for LSAT prep. He is very laid back, but even though attendance is optional you should go because it's very helpful for learning the material. I cannot say enough good things about this course. So much better than having to take calc.

Professor McDaniel is incredibly helpful. I took Elementary Symbolic Logic with him for my math requirement because I hate math, and he was very good at explaining the often esoteric concepts. He is also one of the most approachable professors I've had and loves it when you come to his office hours for help. I highly recommend him.
take him!! especially for a math requirement

Amazing prof. Hilarious, got me interested in the subject and explained very difficult subject matter clearly. Always willing to help/explain. Kept opinions to himself, so the class felt comfortable sharing theirs. Also, not bad to look at :)

Professor McDaniel is one of the best professors at the school. He is very interesting to listen to, and he is interested in the material and in his students. He makes class enjoyable to attend and likes to make jokes in class. He is extremely good at explaining difficult material. Take one of his classes if you have the opportunity. Especially 101

One of the best professors in the school. He is an excellent teacher who knows his stuff and how to explain it (often using movies like Zoolander). Very chill, funny and open-minded but still serious about the material. Always available to help with papers or anything at all. If you read and go see him for anything unclear, you can easily get an A.

One of the best professors I have seen at this university. McDaniel makes some difficult topics clear by the way he teaches. He is open for questions and is willing to discuss anything if people are confused. He's a cool young guy who is very helpful and a great professor.
awesome professor. Very open minded, not hard to get an A from. Just be prepared to forget every opinion you ever had before coming to class.

McDaniel's great at Symbolic Logic and he's the one you want for that class.  He's great at clarifying what's taking place behind a symbol and what the difference between placing it in another place vs. where it is now would do.  GREAT prep for the LSAT too!  Expect to make lots of the same deductions on that as you will in this class.  Thanx McD!!

I had him for logic and he was great so decided to take him again for phil 101..NOT AN EASY A!  I always came to class and took lots of notes and studied a ton for the tests, but still didn't get an A.  Kids who never come to class still get a B, so if you want an easy B take this class, but an A is not really an option.

Great professor. He knows his stuff inside and out. Readings every night for homework due the next class day. Discussion in class about the readings. 2 papers mid term final thats it. you'll learn a lot and he challenges any prior beliefs you would have had coming into the class. Prepared think completely differently about yourself.

This guy is awesome. I only took logic for my math gen-ed but I really enjoy it! He is funny and very clear and is always available for help. I will say that THIS CLASS IS NOT EASY. Work-wise, there is only one homework per week and only three tests, but you have to study your ass off. Take it though, its worth it.

Only prof I had @ UR who didn't require attendence. Was a great teacher who went above and beyond to make the subject relatable and understandable. Free textbook which was not good quality, but hey it's free, and homework load was reasonable. Thought logic was the most usless subject ever, but if you take it, take it from him. He will make it great

I did not know what to expect coming into this course. Prof. McDaniel is a very good teacher who really wants you to learn and will help in any way he can. Attendance was not mandatory, and the weekly homework is given out on Fridays to be completed by the following Monday.
